harper: Heads-up from a customer run: when using the Rust SDK with cursor pagination + client-side prefetch, we see duplicate page fetches that burn quota fast. Repro on staging.

kai: Can you describe the exact flow?

harper: Sequence: 1) page size=50 2) client prefetch=2 (fetch next pages in background) 3) occasionally the cursor returned by server is mutated (append-only token) and Rust SDK retries the old cursor path, causing page N to be fetched twice.

nina: Does JS SDK behave the same?

harper: No, JS has a small check: it compares `cursor.version` before emitting prefetch jobs and drops prefetch when token changes. Rust lacks that parity guard.

sam: Interesting. Logs?

harper: Logs: ```
[2026-02-12T12:01:05Z] fetch_page(cursor=tok_abc123) -> ok
[2026-02-12T12:01:05Z] prefetch_spawn(cursor=tok_abc123)
[2026-02-12T12:01:06Z] fetch_page(cursor=tok_def456) -> ok
[2026-02-12T12:01:06Z] prefetch_execute(cursor=tok_abc123) -> ok (duplicate)
```

kai: Is the server returning a new cursor before acking the prior request? That could cause races in prefetch windows.

harper: Yes, server sometimes issues a new token when it compacts results. Prefetch uses the older token and the SDK retries on 5xx which duplicates work.

sam: Two immediate fixes: 1) add a quick parity guard in Rust SDK to check token identity before launching prefetch, 2) add idempotency for page fetches (client-side dedupe keyed by page id + cursor version).

nina: Also maybe reduce default prefetch from 2 to 1 for SDKs that don't yet have token-identity checks. That reduces duplicate risk for customers.

kai: I can whip up a minimal patch: before spawning a prefetch task, read `current_cursor_ref` under the same lock and validate equality. If mismatch, drop spawn. Small and cheap.

harper: That would help. Can we also instrument a metric `duplicate_page_fetches` and a trace tag `prefetch_cursor_mismatch` so we can quantify impact?

sam: Yes — add both telemetry and a small devex note explaining the parity gap and mitigation. Also call out recommended config: for high churn feeds set `prefetch=0-1`, enable `dedupe_page_requests=true` when available.

nina: I'll add unit tests for the Rust SDK that simulate server cursor rotation + prefetch concurrency and assert no duplicate fetches. Also add an integration smoke in staging with `prefetch=2` to validate.

devex-bot: Issue created: #5120-pagination-dup-work-rust-parity (assigned to kai) https://issues.redwood.ai/5120

kai: ETA for PR with guard + telemetry: tomorrow EOD. Will include test and release note in SDK changelog.

harper: Thanks all. Customer impact: they saw quota use spike ~3x under a 2x concurrent prefetch workload. We'll follow up with incident notes.

sam: Good catch. We'll also add a short blurb in onboarding sampleapp: "If you use prefetch with streaming feeds that rotate cursors, set prefetch <=1 until SDK parity patch lands."

harper: I'll paste perf dump and sample logs in the issue.

sam: :thumbsup:
